candidates.change_summary: Replace the assignment to owner with assignment to msg.sender so caller does not control the resulting owner.
Delete the assignment statement so owner remains unchanged after call.
Assign a constant address (e.g. address(0)) so caller input is ignored and owner becomes predictable wrong value.
Replace assignment with owner = address(this) so owner is set to the contract address.
Remove the onlyAdmin modifier so non-admin callers can change owner.
Replace assignment target with admin state variable so owner is never modified.
Replace `return true;` with `return false;` so the function still succeeds but returns a different boolean value.
Delete `return true;`; the function will compile without an explicit return, and the implicit return value will be the default `false` for bool, changing the observable return value.
Replace the admin check with a constant true to allow any caller to pass the onlyAdmin modifier.
Replace the admin check with a check against msg.sender being the zero address, effectively disabling the admin restriction.
Remove the onlyAdmin modifier from setOwner so any caller can change the owner.
